Author: Kongool
Name: Fatum Voice Chat
Description: Voice-to-text chat, transcribed locally with Whisper: fully offline, no cloud, no API keys. Use push-to-talk, toggle, or hands-free voice activation, with hotkeys routed to different chat channels. Sends automatically, or opens a review box first. Requires a Whisper ggml model file; see the README for the download.
Punchline: Speak into your mic and it lands in FFXIV chat.
